shortDescription: A framework for magical "entad" items: randomly rolled, rarity-scaled traits on weapons, apparel and furniture that reveal themselves through use, can be bound to a pawn's bloodline, and give durability, moods, abilities, damage effects and building bonuses.
body:
## Binding (EntadBinding.cs)
- An entad can be bound to one or more pawns (`CompEntad.Bind`, `EntadApi.Bind/Unbind/GetBoundPawns/TraitsActiveFor`, dev actions "Bind Entad to pawn" / "Unbind Entad"). Unbound = traits work for everyone.
- Bound items work as ordinary items for anyone; traits only work and reveal for bound pawns and their descendants (Parent relations, BFS depth 16, cached per pawn per item).
- Gated per user: wearer stats, held-item stats, damage and weapon effects, abilities, equipped hediffs, equipped/furniture/kill moods, meals, reveals, furniture abilities, reloading. Always on: durability, market value, building properties, unheld items, turret guns.
- `bindOnFirstUse`: first player-faction pawn to equip or use it for themselves (never during generation).
- WorldPawnGC keeps bound pawns and their descendants. Discarded pawns filtered on save.
- UI: inspect "Bound to" (full names), info card row (red when holder is outside the bloodline; damage rows hidden for them), traits tooltip note, alert "Entad bound to another bloodline" for colonists and slaves incl. caravans.

## Weapon effects (EntadWeaponTraits.cs, stage 1)
- `weaponProperties` (rolled, rarity-scaled): BurstShotCount factor (round up), BurstShotSpeed factor (divides ticks between shots), StoppingPower offset. Burst properties only on weapons that already burst; stopping power only on projectile weapons. Rarity cap: no value past x3 / +3, factors can't scale to nothing.
- Info card: the vanilla Burst shot count, Burst fire rate and Stopping power rows are rewritten (postfix on ThingDef.SpecialDisplayStats) to the value actually used, with the same rounding as the Verb getters, vanilla unique-weapon traits folded in first, and an "Entad traits" section in the tooltip. Only revealed traits count on the card.
- `ignoreAccuracyMaluses`: weather accuracy, weather range cap, blind smoke (hit chance, target search, gizmo note), the same four sites vanilla checks for unique weapons.
- `equippedHediffs`: added to the brain on equip (Grant), removed on unequip unless other active gear gives them. Reveal kind `Hediff`, revealed on equip. Example: Clarity (Entad_Hediff_Clarity, +5% consciousness, +10% learning).
- `killThought`: plain non-social memory on each kill via ThingComp.Notify_KilledPawn (killer = wielder). Reveals the Mood kind. To be folded into the trigger system.
- Weapon properties and accuracy reveal with the Damage kind (when a shot lands).
- `partialStats`: a trait may roll on items where only some of its stats apply; the others are hidden on the card.
- Traits: Rapid Volley, Quickfire, Impact Rounds, Stormsight, Battle Joy (+ Entad_Thought_BattleJoy), Clarity.

## Reloadable abilities (EntadReload.cs)
- Trait fields `abilityAmmo`, `abilityAmmoPerCharge` (default 1), `abilityReloadTicks` (default 60); need abilities + abilityCharges. Weapons and apparel only.
- The AbilityDef copy has no cooldown (cooldownPerCharge, no group, no external cooldown), so charges only come back by reloading.
- Charges live on the pawn's Ability while equipped and on the trait (`StoredCharges`) otherwise; EntadAbilities moves them on grant/revoke, always writing back on revoke so two items sharing one Ability can't refill each other. SlotsFor offers one slot per AbilityDef.
- Vanilla's reload code only knows its own comps, so: `Entad_Reload` JobDef + JobDriver_EntadReload (copy of vanilla's), FloatMenuOptionProvider_EntadReload (right-click ammo), postfix on JobGiver_Reload.TryGiveJob (auto-reload when empty). All exit on a static "any reloadable trait" flag.
- Card line "Charges x / y, reloaded with <ammo> (n per charge)". Example trait: Stun Charge (Royalty, Stun x3, 10 chemfuel per charge).

## Durability
- MaxHitPoints × `EntadSettings.Durability[highest trait rarity]` (defaults 1.25/1.5/2/3/5). Never hidden. HP keeps its fraction on changes.

## Furniture mood and abilities
- Prefix on `Pawn_JobTracker.CleanupCurrentJob`: work/recreation/own use at chairs, beds, eating tables. `Thought_EntadFurniture` keyed by thingIDNumber; longer expiry wins at the stack cap.
- Furniture abilities run through the `Entad_UseFurnitureAbility` job (Defs/EntadJobs.xml).

## Random mood traits
- `MoodCandidates`: single visible-stage plain memories from all mods; no traits/genes/hediffs/gender/expectation requirements, adult-stage allowed, no chains or placeholders.

## Localization
- All player text keyed `EF_` in `Languages/English/Keyed/EntadFramework.xml`. Debug actions and logs stay English.

## Settings
- Tabs General / Rarity and durability / Traits; trait list shows rarity or "Variable"; search covers stats, properties, abilities, fuels, damage, weapon effects, hediffs, kill moods.

## Save compatibility
- Removed traits map through `Patch_BackCompatibleDefName`. A trait whose saved name differs re-rolls fully; a trait whose value lists changed length re-rolls only those lists (keeps moods, meal rolls, cooldowns, stored charges).

## Planned
- Next: trigger system. Events: kill, wake up, finish a crafting bill, finish a job type, take damage, get downed, eat. Effects: mood memory, timed hediff, heal X HP, restore rest/food/joy. Optional chance, cooldown, rarity scaling. killThought becomes one case. First example: heal when downed.
- Stage 2: Persona trait (vanilla bondedWeapon slot and equip lock, bonded hediffs/thoughts, Jealous, patch ThoughtWorker_WeaponTraitBonded).
- Stage 3: an EntadTraitDef per WeaponTraitDef (commonality → rarity, exclusionTags → conflicts, call its Worker).
- Stage 4: intercept unique/persona weapon creation and make plain-def entads; settings default on, DLC-gated, "exactly like vanilla" sub-setting.

## Open items
- Def hot-reload doesn't re-run the injectors.
- Lineage cache isn't invalidated if a mod adds parent relations mid-game.
- Kill moods also fire on slaughter and hunting kills (same as vanilla kill thoughts).
- A same-length retune of a trait's value lists keeps old rolls under the new meaning (reviewer suggestion: re-roll values outside the current range).
- Circinus palette pins: the last pinned entry has failed in each of the last three runs (launcher side, not the mod).
